device_scope: One previously paired Android test phone connected to maintenance USB, with two locally stored approved AI grant records and its existing VPN active.
actor: Maintainer network fault injection and Android diagnostics; not a personal-AI business task.
change_under_test: A newly usable default-network path resets stale failure backoff once. Identical capability callbacks keep the current timer; capability changes leave an existing healthy or in-flight socket intact. Remaining usable physical transports can count as a route switch; a transition to VPN-only does not itself accelerate retry.

upgrade.maintainer_intervention: After installing, the maintainer opened the owner Activity to prepare diagnostics, then returned to the launcher. The Activity remained in the background during the network test.
upgrade.limit: This is maintained installation and diagnostic preparation, not autonomous upgrade recovery. A local record count does not validate both original AI credentials.

network_test.method: Disable mobile data, disable Wi-Fi, confirm no default network, hold the outage for about 25 seconds, then enable Wi-Fi and observe recovery. Restore the captured radio settings.
network_test.recovered_condition: Phone diagnostics reported connected transport and acknowledged multi-AI handshake, with unchanged local device registration and a local approved grant record count of two.
network_test.measurement_limit: One run. Timing runs from Wi-Fi enable to the first sampled protocol-ready state, not exact ACK arrival. It includes Wi-Fi and VPN restoration, transport establishment and sampling; it is not a latency distribution or service guarantee.

single_run_comparison.procedure: The same maintainer fault-injection procedure was applied to the same test phone on code50 and code51.
single_run_comparison.causal_limit: The code50 connection attempt after network return failed and waited for another retry; the corresponding code51 attempt succeeded directly. The entire timing difference cannot be attributed to resetting retry backoff.
single_run_comparison.coverage_limit: A failed connection attempt after network return was not triggered in this code51 physical run. The first-tier retry after that failure is covered by synthetic regression tests.
single_run_comparison.failure_source: The code50 TLS EOF source is undetermined; it is not attributed to the relay, VPN provider or carrier.

local_build_and_core_checks.scope: Local host synthetic checks and workerd. These are separate from physical-device, personal-AI, public-relay capacity and billing acceptance.

evidence.network_artifact_review: A separate read-only artifact review checked the test timeline, diagnostics, radio restoration and logs. Its reviewer did not inject the phone fault, but also authored the code fix; this is not an external independent audit.

not_verified: A personal-AI business task on code51; this record covers the maintainer network run only.
Post-outage status using both original personal-AI credentials on code51.
Two personal AIs handing off or contending for a live task on this phone.
Cold start, reboot, unpowered or long idle, screen unlocking, or recovery after user stop/revocation.
Mobile-data-only operation or operation without the existing VPN.
Migration of another phone from its existing control chain.
Repeated recovery trials, other devices or a complete end-to-end product acceptance pass.
publication_boundary: Aggregate versions, timings, counts and failure limits only. No screenshots, user content, credentials, network addresses, device or connection identifiers, or private paths.
